symbols.name: source axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries along the source axis, counted by s.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the number of entries along the source axis and $t$ the number along the target axis, with $\gcd(s,t)=1$.

symbols.name: target axis length
symbols.meaning: The number of entries along the target axis, counted by t.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the number of entries along the source axis and $t$ the number along the target axis, with $\gcd(s,t)=1$.

symbols.name: identity parameter
symbols.meaning: An integer parameter of the resampling identity, appearing as the exponent $2^{2\alpha^2}$.
symbols.quote: Let $\alpha$ be an integer parameter of the identity.

symbols.name: source permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation of the source axis.
symbols.quote: $P_s$ is the source coordinate permutation, which reorders the $s$ entries of each source axis.

symbols.name: source transform
symbols.meaning: The one-dimensional transform of length $s_i$ applied along each source axis $i$.
symbols.quote: $F_s$ applies the one-dimensional transform of length $s$ along each source axis.

symbols.name: target permutation
symbols.meaning: The coordinate permutation of the target axis.
symbols.quote: $P_t$ is the target coordinate permutation, which reorders the $t$ entries of each target axis, and $F_t$ applies the one-dimensional transform of length $t$ along each target axis.

symbols.name: target transform
symbols.meaning: The one-dimensional transform of length $t$ applied along each target axis.
symbols.quote: $P_t$ is the target coordinate permutation, which reorders the $t$ entries of each target axis, and $F_t$ applies the one-dimensional transform of length $t$ along each target axis.

symbols.name: source-to-target contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the source axis to the target axis.
symbols.quote: $A$ is a linear contraction from the source axis to the target axis.

symbols.name: target-to-source contraction
symbols.meaning: A linear contraction from the target axis back to the source axis.
symbols.quote: $B_0$ is a linear contraction from the target axis back to the source axis.

symbols.name: retained source permutation
symbols.meaning: The source permutation kept inside the formula.
symbols.quote: Let $R$ be the source permutation kept in the formula, and let $F_s^{+}$ be the opposite transform, the transform with the sign of its roots of unity reversed.

symbols.name: opposite source transform
symbols.meaning: The opposite transform, the transform with the sign of its roots of unity reversed.
symbols.quote: Let $R$ be the source permutation kept in the formula, and let $F_s^{+}$ be the opposite transform, the transform with the sign of its roots of unity reversed.

symbols.name: first input array
symbols.meaning: An array indexed by the source box.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $S=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

symbols.name: second input array
symbols.meaning: An array indexed by the source box.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $S=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

symbols.name: source box size
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in the source box, the product of the source axis lengths $s_i$.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $S=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

relations.quote: The identity rests on [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md): its one-dimensional form $P_sF_s = 2^{2\alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA$ holds with linear contractions $A$ and $B_0$.
